sentences.text: ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE N.V.ANJARIA) The Division Bench passed order dated 22 nd September, 2021 while disposing of Special Civil Application No. 10878 of 2021 and allied petitions.

The directions brought under contempt jurisdiction of this court reads as under:
"In view of the aforesaid, no specific time limit as prayed for can be fixed as to not three months as prayed for by the petitioners.

The authorities are directed to expedite Mohanbhai Manilal Tadvi vs Dipakbhai S Baria, Special Land ... on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188572332/
1 the process of land acquisition as averred by them in the affidavit-in-reply and complete the same without any further delay, preferably within a period of one year.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per the above observations, the respondents were required to expedite the process of land acquisition.
It was their stand also in the affidavit-in-reply.
The authorities were required to complete the NEUTRAL CITATION C/MCA/1315/2022 ORDER DATED: 18/01/2023 undefined proceedings within preferable time of one year as indicated in the order.
3. By very nature of the order, it could be seen that any time limit is not prescribed for the authorities to comply with the directions.
The authorities could be said to have breathing time even after one year since the stipulation of one year of time was only a preferable condition.

3.1 Learned Assistant Government Pleader Mr. Krutik Parikh, however, was fair to make a statement that necessary notification under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, would be issued by the competent authority within two weeks from today and the entire process would be completed thereafter as per the time schedule provided in the statute and in any case within six months from the date of issuance of the notification.
4. In view of the above, contempt proceedings against the respondents are not liable to be continued any further.

sentences.text: The respondents shall abide by their statement and complete the proceedings in question as per the time limit recorded as above.
5. This Misc. Civil Application is disposed of.
